arguments.command:
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native timeout -s KILL 300 python3 public_check.py 2>&1 | tail -2 && ls -la submission && python3 -c "
import os
tot=0;n=0
for root,dirs,files in os.walk('submission'):
    n+=len(dirs)
    for f in files:
        p=os.path.join(root,f); tot+=os.lstat(p).st_size; n+=1
        assert not os.path.islink(p)
print('submission: %d entries, %d bytes (limits: 256 entries, 8MiB)' % (n,tot))
"
